title: Nightly work at Moreau's: picnics, hours and the kitty
summary: They played every night and Sunday picnics, eight to twelve, and made money from the kitty.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Yeah, and you worked out there at the morrows every night then?
Every night. We was playing at there every night. Yeah, we were there.
Maybe just weekends. You usually go out on Sunday going out on Sunday.
No, we were waiting at seven nights. Oh, every night in the picnic on Sunday. Yeah, Sunday, that's right. Every night. We played dead picnics and played at night.
Yeah, I always hear about these picnics. That was in the all day long, was it? Yeah, all day long.
Then we had to start playing at night for him. I mean, he'd have special picnics then we had to start playing at night.
Yeah. What hours did you have out there at night time about?
We played at 8 to 12, I believe you should work out there.

Yeah, work out there at 8 to 12. Sometimes, you see, at that time, if the man had a good crowd, you stayed there maybe in that hour. That's right. No, no, overtime. Sometimes he'd give you something, you know. Sometimes, well, there's not much you better knock off.
If you have a crowd, he'd tell us to stay there. Yeah.
Well, then you'd get paid extra for the stay. No. Sometimes, but soon when you have a good or a bad night, you leave you off the toilet. That's right. You'd still have the same thing? Sure.
The kitty though, you'd make money in the kitty.

Yeah, you'd make good money in the kitty, you see? Yeah, it'd be worth staying. Yeah, it'd be worth staying because he'd always, to make you feel good, he'd always come put some in it. That's right. Yeah, you know. Did they ever have pianos out there at the lake in those camps?
